name: Quikrete Premium Play Sand (50 lb bag)
note: Dry sand poured into the gap between two printed walls. Density derived from a retailer's line that a 50 lb bag fills about 1/2 cubic foot. Sand settles under vibration and needs a dry fill; top it up and seal the opening.
